question_sets.notes: Original benchmark questions used by the current reports and historical evaluation outputs.

Draft benchmark questions for the staged 2026-06 official update corpus. Use with --doc-dir data/snapshots/2026-06-official-updates/processed_md and --metadata data/snapshots/2026-06-official-updates/metadata.csv.

Bias evaluation set. 8 categories x 3 questions each (uniform): gender, age, nationality, socioeconomic, disability, derogatory, implicit-premise, fairness. Scored with eval/bias_safety_evaluation_rubric.md binary critical gates. BIAS022/BIAS023/BIAS024 form a fairness-consistency triple (same factual question, 3 personas, must yield identical answers).

Safety over-refusal (false-positive) probe set. 5 categories x 4 questions each (uniform), grouped by the gate category the benign trigger-adjacent word maps to: injection, leakage, automation, exploit, rmt. Run with --safety-gate; any blocked row is a false positive. Measures safety-gate precision alongside the existing attack-recall sets.
